# Kivov Digital

> Kivov Digital is a Toronto-based, workflow-first AI consultancy for small and mid-sized businesses. It maps how work actually happens, finds where time is being lost, and builds practical AI and automation systems around the way a team already works, instead of forcing the business into a new platform. Founded by Kim Wong, a former Deloitte and EY consultant with 7+ years in software development, enterprise integrations, cloud architecture and AI.

Key facts:

- Location: Toronto, Ontario, Canada. Calls run live on Zoom.
- Approach: start with the workflow, not the tool. Every engagement begins by understanding one real process; the audit also names what should *not* be automated.
- Prices are public and in CAD:
  - Workflow Fit Check: free, about 3 minutes, eight questions, high-level result.
  - Workflow-First AI Audit: CAD $495 founding-client price for the first five clients (standard CAD $750). One priority workflow → map, bottlenecks, prioritized opportunities, written 30-day action plan, walkthrough. CAD $500 is credited if you hire Kivov for implementation within 30 days.
  - Build With You: CAD $1,250 billed every 4 weeks. Two 45-minute strategy calls a month, custom Claude skills and automations built alongside your team, always-on text support with a 12 business-hour response SLA, documentation hub. 100% money-back guarantee if you're not satisfied with the results.
  - Build For You: CAD $5,500 per project. One workflow taken end-to-end (up to ~two core system integrations): architecture, implementation, testing, exception handling, team handoff, 30-day stabilization. Starts with discovery or a completed audit.
- Contact: hello@kivov.work · replies within one business day.
